page_title: MNT 2-6 PSG | Montpellier v PSG 17/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+2' Gianluigi Donnarumma is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Khalil Fayad (Montpellier). Easy save!
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' It is time for a substitution. Christopher Jullien (Montpellier) is on for Teji Savanier.
89' 2 - 6 Goal! Vitinha displays great vision and sends a pass to Nuno Mendes (PSG), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball inside the left post. The score is 2:6.
88' What a chance that is! Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the left post!
87' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
87' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Montpellier force their opponents to concede a corner.
86' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Teji Savanier (Montpellier).
85' Leo Leroy (Montpellier) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball is out of play and Montpellier manage to earn a corner.
85' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

85' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the left side of the goal. Gianluigi Donnarumma is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save. The ball goes out for a corner. Montpellier can continue in their attacking effort.
83' The Montpellier players are stunned as referee Florent Batta changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
82' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Montpellier as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
82' Nuno Mendes (PSG) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Florent Batta signals. That is a penalty kick for Montpellier.
81' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) connects with a pass inside the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post.
81' PSG keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
78' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman signals a throw-in for PSG.
74' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
72' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
72' Nuno Mendes (PSG) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and can count himself very lucky that the referee didn't issue a red card.
72' Montpellier couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Gianluigi Donnarumma (PSG) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
71' Florent Batta has a clear sight and sees a foul from Senny Mayulu (PSG). Montpellier have a free kick.
71' Nuno Mendes (PSG) strikes the ball from a long-range free kick. His shot only flies miles away of the right post. What a poor kick!
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) comes onto the pitch for Lucas Mincarelli.
70' Here is a change. Kang-In Lee is going off and Luis Enrique gives the last tactical orders to Senny Mayulu (PSG).
69' The referee signals a substitution. Nordi Mukiele (PSG) is brought on as a substitute for Lucas Beraldo.

68' Great solo effort by Vitinha (PSG) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save.
66' The PSG players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
63' 2 - 5 Goal! Vitinha provides Kylian Mbappe (PSG) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort inside the left post. 2:5.
62' Luis Enrique has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Goncalo Ramos (PSG) replacing Randal Kolo Muani.
62' Bradley Barcola will be replaced by Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG).
60' Substitution. Arnaud Nordin will be replaced by Khalil Fayad (Montpellier).
59' Michel Der Zakarian prepares a substitution. Wahbi Khazri is replaced by Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier).
59' A substitution has been made. Tanguy Coulibaly is replaced by Akor Adams (Montpellier).
58' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
56' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
56' Vitinha (PSG) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

53' 2 - 4 Brilliant finish! Kang-In Lee (PSG) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Randal Kolo Muani, then produced a nice strike into the top left corner. The score is 2:4.

50' 2 - 3 Bradley Barcola looks around to decide who he is going to pass to. He picks out Kylian Mbappe (PSG), who collects the ball perfectly and unleashes a terrific shot that ricochets in off the crossbar. The score is 2:3.
48' Manuel Ugarte (PSG) commits a rough challenge and Florent Batta blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Half-time substitution. Lucas Hernandez will not participate anymore and Nuno Mendes (PSG) is coming on.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' Florent Batta blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+5' Vitinha (PSG) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball low towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Dimitry Bertaud, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
45+1' The referee shows a yellow card to Gianluigi Donnarumma (PSG). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
45+1' 2 - 2 Goal! Gianluigi Donnarumma gets a hand on the penalty from Teji Savanier (Montpellier), but can't stop it from flying into the top left corner.
45+1' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is going to take the penalty!
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' Gianluigi Donnarumma (PSG) commits a rough foul. Florent Batta stops the game and makes a call. The referee points to the penalty spot. Montpellier are awarded a penalty kick!

41' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) gathers a nice lofted pass deep inside the box and attempts to put the ball low into the middle of the goal, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players.
38' Lucas Beraldo (PSG) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
36' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
36' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from PSG comes to nothing. PSG have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
34' Bradley Barcola (PSG) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. PSG win a corner kick.
34' Montpellier failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
33' The ball is cleared after Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Montpellier force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
30' 1 - 2 Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the bottom right corner, and thus alter the score to 1:2.
27' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

26' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat. The ball goes behind for a corner. Montpellier will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

26' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Gianluigi Donnarumma makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the middle of the target. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Montpellier.
26' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Dimitry Bertaud makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
22' 0 - 2 Goal! Kylian Mbappe (PSG) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Randal Kolo Muani inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:2.
21' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) takes the corner but it's cleared.

21' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Montpellier will have a corner.
20' One of the defending players blocks a long-range shot which was unleashed by Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier).
19' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Florent Batta blows for a foul.
16' Lucas Mincarelli (Montpellier) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley high over the bar.

14' 0 - 1 Goal! Great link up play between Vitinha (PSG) and Kylian Mbappe gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom right corner. 0:1.
13' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
13' Bradley Barcola (PSG) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
12' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) unleashes a shot from 40 metres out but is unable to find the target and it goes high over the crossbar.
10' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
9' Leo Leroy (Montpellier) receives a pass then lets rip from long range towards the bottom left corner, but Gianluigi Donnarumma watches it all the way and makes an easy save.
8' The game is interrupted as Lucas Hernandez (PSG) is flagged offside.
5' Montpellier couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Gianluigi Donnarumma (PSG) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
4' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) brings his opponent down. Florent Batta has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Montpellier will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
3' The referee blows his whistle as Leo Leroy (Montpellier) was too aggressive in his challenge.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Montpellier will kick the game off.
Florent Batta was nominated as the referee for this game.
